passages.label: First Notice of Loss narrative
passages.text:
The claimant reports that their vehicle was traveling northbound on Karlov Avenue at night. The claimant says the road was wet and visibility was limited by darkness, although the roadway was illuminated.

The claimant reports that the vehicle was turning right when it came into contact with a parked vehicle. The claimant says they did not initially realize how significant the contact was.

The claimant states that they stopped briefly, looked at the vehicles, and then left because they were concerned about being stranded late at night. The claimant says they did not see anyone inside the parked vehicle and did not believe anyone was injured.
